name: allegro_search
description: Search for products on Allegro.pl. Returns a list of offers with prices and IDs.

sort.description: Sort: p=price asc, pd=price desc, m=relevance, n=newest

name: allegro_offer_details
description: Get detailed specifications and price for a specific Allegro offer.

offer_id.description: The unique ID of the offer

name: allegro_compare
description: Compare other sellers of the same Allegro product or multipack using the Other Offers panel. Returns cheapest/fastest summaries and the first cheapest-sorted listing page. Always check complete, offerCount and returnedOfferCount: results can be partial. Smart badges and displayed delivery totals are not checkout guarantees.

offer_id.description: ID of the source offer whose product or product set should be compared

name: allegro_cart_list
description: List all items currently in the user's Allegro shopping cart.

name: allegro_cart_add
description: Add a specific offer to the shopping cart.

name: allegro_cart_remove
description: Remove a specific item from the shopping cart.

name: allegro_track_packages
description: Get a list of all active shipments and their current delivery status.

name: allegro_orders_list
description: List past Allegro orders with status, price, and tracking info. Supports filtering by status and title search.

limit.description: Number of orders to fetch (default: 15, max: 50)

compact.description: Return minimal fields for token efficiency

name: allegro_orders_reorder
description: Re-add all reorderable items from a past order to the shopping cart. Only items with CAN_BUY_AGAIN trait are added.

order_id.description: The order ID to reorder (from allegro_orders_list)

name: allegro_orders_returns
description: List orders currently in return or transit-return status (RETURNED, RETURN_IN_PROGRESS).
